page_title: ETI 3-3 ANG | St Etienne v Angers 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' 3 - 3 Goal! Bamba Dieng (Angers) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Gautier Larsonneur.
90+2' Bamba Dieng (Angers) is going to take the penalty!
90+1' Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Farid El Melali (Angers) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) plays a lovely through ball to Augustine Boakye, but he can't beat Yahia Fofana and loses the ball.
90' The resulting corner from Farid El Melali (Angers) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
89' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
87' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
86' Bamba Dieng (Angers) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
85' CHANCE! Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
84' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
84' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
83' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
82' Eirik Horneland is forced to make a change. Irvin Cardona is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Augustine Boakye (St Etienne).
82' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' Bamba Dieng (Angers) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
80' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marius Courcoul (Angers) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
78' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) takes the free kick but it's straight at the goalkeeper.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bamba Dieng (Angers) comes onto the pitch so that Jim Allevinah can be given a rest.
77' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Pierrick Capelle is replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lilian Rao-Lisoa walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).
73' 3 - 2 Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and drills in a superb strike that finds its way into the middle of the net.
73' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' Great save! Leo Petrot (St Etienne) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Yahia Fofana.

72' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
70' The linesman raises his flag. Louis Mouton (St Etienne) is adjudged offside.
67' Substitution. Benjamin Bouchouari did his best and is replaced by Louis Mouton (St Etienne).
67' Eirik Horneland decides to make a substitution. Yvann Macon will be replaced by Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne).
67' A pass from Jim Allevinah (Angers) is intercepted by Gautier Larsonneur and the move breaks down.
65' St Etienne take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
63' Florent Hanin (Angers) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
62' That will be all from Ibrahima Niane who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sidiki Cherif (Angers).
61' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Zinedine Ferhat and he is replaced by Farid El Melali (Angers).
61' Pierrick Capelle (Angers) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
61' The ratio of the ball possession is 67:33.
58' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
56' Lovely run from Jim Allevinah (Angers). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
54' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

52' 2 - 2 Stunning strike! Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) latches on to a precise through ball from Zuriko Davitashvili before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the back of the net from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 2:2.
51' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' A pass by Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
47' What a big chance! Jim Allevinah (Angers) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
46' Half-time substitution. Eirik Horneland decided to make a change. Djyilian N'Guessan is replaced by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the left side of the goal, but Yahia Fofana keeps it out with an amazing save.
45+3' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the crossbar. Good effort!
45+2' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Florent Hanin (Angers) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gautier Larsonneur intercepts the ball.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
44' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Yahia Fofana.
42' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
40' A crossfield pass from Florent Hanin (Angers) fails to find any of his teammates.
40' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
39' Mickael Nade (St Etienne) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
38' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

36' 1 - 2 Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:2.
35' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for St Etienne.
35' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and it's Ibrahima Niane (Angers) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' The game is interrupted now, Ibrahima Niane (Angers) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
31' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
30' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Yahia Fofana is equal to it and makes an easy save.

29' What a poor attempt! Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
28' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Florian Tardieu (St Etienne), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
28' St Etienne will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yvann Macon (St Etienne) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

25' Jim Allevinah (Angers) meets a nice cross deep inside the 18-yard box and produces a fine header towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is well positioned and punches the ball away, deflecting it onto the post.
21' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) tries to find Florian Tardieu, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
18' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
17' 0 - 2 Goal! Himad Abdelli (Angers) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:2.
16' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) commits a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Yahia Fofana displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
13' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) is adjudged offside.
11' The foul by Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) was seen by Bastien Dechepy who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne).
9' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Himad Abdelli (Angers) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Gautier Larsonneur into the bottom right corner.
6' Himad Abdelli (Angers) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
5' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
4' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Florent Hanin (Angers) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. St Etienne will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy was nominated as the referee for this game.
